# De Mott OS — shell

The static shell for [De Mott OS](https://github.com/jamesdemott/de-mott-os), so
the phone has something to open when the Mac is in a bag.

**Code only.** This repo holds no personal data. It is generated by
`build_shell.sh` in the private repo, which copies from an allow-list and then
asserts that nothing from `data/` reached the build. The app fetches data
separately and authenticated, with a token the reader supplies themselves.

Do not edit anything here by hand — it is overwritten on the next build.
